content.comment_body: Firmware update V2.1.7 is now available for [product_name] ([article_no]) and [product_name] ([article_no]). Product improvements: [product_name]: - Time synchronization via GPS: All systems connected with [product_name] should update the assembly time via GPS. Due to a counter overflow in the GPS receiver (GPS rollover), older firmware versions will experience incorrect GPS time synchronization from November 2, 2019, at 23:59:42 UTC. Upgrading to firmware version V2.1.7 is highly recommended to prevent this issue. - The [product_name] is not impacted by this GPS related issue. - Communication via VPN: Data throughput over VPN for the [product_name] has been increased. - SMS transmission: The sporadic issue where SMS could not be sent after upgrading firmware from V1.x to V2.x has been resolved. [product_name] and [product_name]: - SMS user groups: The issue where SMS messages were sent incorrectly to user groups 1 and 2 instead of groups 9 and 10 has been corrected. - Name resolution (DNS): The processes for time synchronization via NTP, DynDNS, and email have been improved. Note: Currently, language selection on this website does not function properly, so this information is only available in German.

analysis.insight_summary: The post details a firmware update (V2.1.7) for [product_name], describing resolved issues and improvements such as a fix for GPS time synchronization related to GPS rollover, enhancements in VPN data throughput, and corrections to SMS transmission and user group messaging. It emphasizes the importance of updating to avoid significant GPS time errors and SMS disruptions. Improvements also include refined DNS-based time synchronization.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect reliable GPS time synchronization, improved VPN data rates, consistent SMS delivery, and proper user group messaging after firmware updates, without the need for additional manual steps.
